metric: classwise AP and macro mAP; sample SD and paired seed differences
loss: paper per-unit positive C1, negative 1; no class-count normalization
bias: sMIL/mi-SVM free; CPB regularized using Q=K+1 without alpha-y equality
MI_update: sign predictions, repair only violating bags; same for noPI/PI/DA
CPB_oracle: Algorithm2 bag-coordinate enumeration, ties preserve incumbent; approximate globally
DA: explicit alpha<=C2*theta, theta>=0, sum theta=n; mu=(n*C2)^2/lambda
hyperparameters: paper C1/gamma starts (sMIL 100/100, instance 0.01/10); DA C2 10 or 1e-5, lambda=100; C1 scale only on validation
negative_results: all conditions retained; no test-directed tuning or dropped classes/seeds
status_semantics: QP/MKL failure recorded and blocks selection; label cycles and iteration limits reported separately from stability
coverage: core all-family controls and full/shuffled PI, KMM; natural cross-dataset/action accuracy and other literature baselines remain separate stages
solver_policy: OSQP QP; CPB Clarabel then SCS only on nonoptimal; original residual <=1e-6
